tip_surface_witness.tie_scope: All exact body-edge ties for this tip; positive-distance global ties are not enumerated
tip_surface_witness.scope: Unsigned tip-to-actual-Q1-boundary distance; not contact or penetration

J_min.witness_rule: First C-order exact tie; the tie count is retained, not a uniqueness claim

J_max.witness_rule: First C-order exact tie; the tie count is retained, not a uniqueness claim

Hu.position_scope: Hu is constant per element/component; Q1 center is a representative marker, not a sampling point
Hu.witness_rule: First C-order exact tie; not a unique maximum claim

Green_principal_min.witness_rule: First C-order exact tie; the tie count is retained, not a uniqueness claim

Green_principal_max.witness_rule: First C-order exact tie; the tie count is retained, not a uniqueness claim

displacement_mm.scope: Saved binary64 lift+fluctuation sum, independent of world-coordinate subtraction; no small-value clipping

outer_boundary_displacement_mm.scope: Saved binary64 lift+fluctuation sum; displayed actual coordinates can round sub-ulp displacements

right_medium.scope: Original saved binary64 J/Hu and in-plane Green strain from saved F; no fresh constitutive evaluation or pressure qualification

derived.scope: Binary64 saved F and actual raster geometry; no fresh HP, pressure or contact qualification

boundary.actual_coordinate_definition: coordinates + lift + fluctuation; millimetres; scale one
boundary.method: Unsigned Euclidean distances of actual straight Q1 outer edges; no signed penetration

all_exposed.intersection_semantics: Crossing or raw zero-distance touch/overlap; positive roundoff near-touch is separate

boundary.circle_representation: native cell staircase; no analytic circle fit

boundary_intersections.intersection_semantics: Crossing or raw zero-distance touch/overlap; positive roundoff near-touch is separate

regions.projection_gap_definition: max(minA,minB)-min(maxA,maxB) on each unit edge-normal; mm; not penetration depth
regions.boundary_scope: Topologically exposed closed-region edges including any symmetry cut; self-overlap not tested; not physical contact boundaries

geometry.scope: Actual Q1 boundary distance and cross-cell interior overlap only; complete set containment and mechanism self-overlap not tested

descriptive.scope: New ordinary arithmetic observations only. Signed positive/negative sums and differences retained; no clipping or numerical acceptance tolerance.

fixed_coordinate_source_contract.viewer_lines: 480-482: both lift/fluctuation on all workpiece DOFs must be exactly zero before observations
fixed_coordinate_source_contract.nodal_semantics: All fixed body nodes, four mutually exclusive masks with physical/cut intersection separate; ON-body=-saved internal weak vectors; original holding total opposes total; positions copied from reference coordinates, therefore actual for this fixed body

scope: Existing peak fixed lower-half workpiece node weak forces in N, at fixed body coordinates in mm. ON-body vectors are the original negative internal weak force. The original total holding reaction opposes ON-body total; component-wise holding glyphs are algebraic negatives for display, not independent reaction measurements. No pressure, continuous face traction, radial pressure projection, mirror doubling or qualified effective grip. Raw node/mask/group values retained. New sums/differences are descriptive only, without a tolerance or acceptance gate. No new F/T/HP/equilibrium/tests/default or API association. These three JSONs do not contain full deformed gripper coordinates.
